smell_validity.evidence: Reference-quality: SensorData absorbed codec, calibration, filename, directory, and demo work from five owners, reducing RGBDFrame, CalibrationData, and StringCounter to single-line forwarders. The hollowed collaborators make the centralization fault and its consequence—types unable to own their behavior—unmistakable without the label.

maintenance_impact.evidence: A lasting trap: codec, calibration, naming, directory, and demo edits all land in the recording type instead of their data owners, forcing unrelated concerns together and obscuring what belongs where. Removing it restores ownership boundaries so each type can change independently.

development_plausibility.evidence: Verbatim bodies (including a preserved unsigned-int-short typo), same ifdef branches, allocation sizes, and mLib conventions make each moved body fit the existing header. The forwarder pattern is a real source-compatibility compromise. Slight artificiality: five clusters centralize simultaneously rather than accreting over time.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: An exceptional contract: it lists each misplaced concern, the targeted ownership, and a detailed preservation boundary—byte-compatible serialization, every format path, allocation sizes, ownership contract, source-compatible API, and error paths—while explicitly requiring complete cleanup and leaving target form unspecified.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Five distinct purposes (filesystem, frame codec, calibration math, filename formatting, demo decode) each need a different target decision: namespace free function, instance member, nested static, nested instance member, or consumer free function. At least three require purpose-specific re-qualification; no single rule covers all.

localization_burden.evidence: The prompt names the two files and concern areas, but the solver must read the header to find the statics, the one-line forwarders, and the lifecycle call sites, then check main.cpp's demo. Several local steps; no cross-component data-flow combination is needed.

repair_coordination.evidence: Within each cluster, removing a SensorData static requires updating its callers (lifecycle methods, dispatchers, main) to the re-homed version; leaving either stale causes a compile failure. Cross-cluster edits are independent. Coordination is compile-level call requalification, not behavioral.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: One uniform rule—converting the ten codec statics (compress/free/decompress) from static-with-RGBDFrame-ref back to RGBDFrame instance members—covers the largest cluster, roughly 10 of 14 misplaced functions (~70%). The other four clusters need different target forms (namespace, nested member, free function).

behavioral_risk.evidence: A mis-routed decompress dispatcher (e.g., TYPE_JPEG to the raw path) compiles but throws MLIB_EXCEPTION on the demo's ordinary processFrame call, covered by existing type assertions. No clear silent wrong-result path from plausible verbatim-move errors; most qualification mistakes fail to compile.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
